covers: rtext.c's LoadFontEx (and LoadFontFromMemory under it) as 6.2 loads a TrueType file: the printable ASCII, only the glyphs the font has (a character it lacks found as its '?'), each Unicode space a blank glyph; each glyph's metrics, its place on the atlas and a checksum of its image
notes: hxcpp alone: helix-ray rasterizes glyphs with the platform's font rasterizer, stb_truetype natively, a canvas in a page, which Node hasn't.
